# EF Core Provider - (current)

> Explore the MongoDB Entity Framework Core Provider to integrate MongoDB with .NET applications using Entity Framework Core for data access and manipulation.

- [Configure the EF Core Provider](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/connect/configure.md): Learn how to configure an application to use the MongoDB Entity Framework Core Provider, including creating POCOs, DB context classes, and connection settings.
- [Get Started with the EF Core Provider](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/get-started.md): Create a .NET application using the EF Core Provider to connect to a MongoDB Atlas cluster, set up a project, and query sample data.
- [MongoDB Entity Framework Core Provider](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/index.md): Explore the MongoDB Entity Framework Core Provider to integrate MongoDB with .NET applications using Entity Framework Core for data access and manipulation.
- [Run an Atlas Vector Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/interact-data/atlas-vector-search.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB EF Core Provider to run an Atlas Vector Search query. See vector embedding types, model definition, index configuration, and query examples.
- [Find and Query Entity Data with LINQ](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/interact-data/query-data.md): Explore how to query MongoDB data using Entity Framework Core with LINQ, including finding, sorting, checking field existence, and retrieving entities.
- [Configure Queryable Encryption](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/interact-data/queryable-encryption.md): Learn how to configure Queryable Encryption in the MongoDB EF Core Provider to encrypt sensitive fields at the application layer before storing them in MongoDB.
- [Quick Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/interact-data/quick-reference.md): Explore provider syntax for various commands in Entity Framework, including configuring a DBContext, finding, inserting, updating, and deleting entities.
- [Batch Changes with Transactions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/interact-data/transactions.md): Learn how to use implicit and explicit transactions with the MongoDB Entity Framework Core Provider, including transaction options, deployment requirements, and limitations.
- [Write Data to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/interact-data/write-data.md): Perform write operations in MongoDB using Entity Framework Core, including inserting, updating, and deleting data with `SaveChanges()` or `SaveChangesAsync()`.
- [Report Issues and Request Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/issues-and-help.md): Report bugs or request features for the EF Core Provider by creating an issue in JIRA, and follow instructions for reporting security vulnerabilities.
- [Feature Limitations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/limitations.md): Discover the limitations of the EF Core Provider for MongoDB, including unsupported features like select projections, migrations, and time series data.
- [Optimize Queries with Indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/model-data/indexes.md): Learn how to define indexes in the EF Core Provider to optimize query performance, including single field, compound, unique indexes, and alternate keys.
- [Ensure Data Consistency with Optimistic Concurrency](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/model-data/optimistic-concurrency.md): Learn about the two ways to implement optimistic concurrency control with the EF Core Provider, which ensures data is not overwritten between reads and writes.
- [Embedded Relationships and Manual References](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/model-data/relationships.md): Learn how to model relationships between entities in MongoDB using the Entity Framework Core Provider, including owned entities and embedded documents.
- [FAQ](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/reference/faq.md): Discover the differences between the .NET/C# driver and the EF Core Provider for MongoDB, including their features and use cases.
- [Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/reference/release-notes.md): Learn what's new in each version of the MongoDB Entity Framework Core Provider, including new features, improvements, bug fixes, and breaking changes.
- [Upgrade Provider Version](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/entity-framework/current/reference/upgrade.md)
